about_the_game:
Introduction

After seeing his neighbor's failing marriage Mr. Blob decides to make a “Honey-Do List” of things he wants to do for his wife to improve their marriage. He’s always been a little klutzy and not very adventurous. Knowing this he goes to the public fountain, tosses some money in, and wishes for help on his list of items to do for his wife. Unbeknownst to him the universe listened. A duo of pixies hearing his wishes decided they were pure in nature and a fair trade for a few coins.

For all three scenarios in this game you will play as pixies in some form or another to help Mr. Blob on his quest to do something special for the wife he loves.

Mr. Blob’s Honey Do List

❖     Go to the moon and get a beautiful moon gem for Mrs. Blob

❖     Collect a bouquet of wild flowers for Mrs. Blob.

❖     Redecorate the house with new furniture for Mrs. Blob

Moon Gem

This is a 2D side scrolling space arcade game. Player 1 will guide Mr. Blob's ship to avoid all incoming asteroids. Player 2 will speed up or slow down asteroids to prevent them from hitting Mr. Blob's passenger ship. The goal is to safely escort Mr. Blob's ship to the moon.

Flower Collection

This is a 2D side view static platformer. Player 1 and 2 must work together to pick up a dozen flowers for Mr. Blob to give to his wife before night sets in. Flowers are placed throughout the level and will re-spawn after being picked up. Avoid the bees as they will sting your pixie and cause the pixie to drop any flowers they are holding. Once 12 flowers have been placed in the basket the level is complete.

House Redecoration

This is a 2D isometric strategic turn based game. Player 1 and 2 must place the new furniture around the room in its designated spots. Mr. Blob will bring in a new piece of furniture after each turn. When picking up the furniture it's optional placement spots will highlight green. If the players run out of turns or the furniture piles up at the entrance the game is lost. Once all furniture has been placed in a valid position the game is won.

End/Credits

This will appear once all items on Mr. Blob's Honey-Do List are complete.

Difficulty

To accommodate players of various skill levels there are three difficulty settings to choose from. Easy, Medium, and Hard.

Note

Nintendo controllers may need to have their A and B buttons reversed.

Go to Steam Settings --> Controllers --> "Enable Steam input for Switch Pro Controllers" and "Use Nintendo Button Layout"

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek Audio or equivalent
  • Additional Notes: Two NES style Game Pads Recommended

short_description: Mr. Blob's Honey-Do List is a local coop NES inspired game. Enjoy three scenarios each with different game play styles and comic relief.
